author: SagBags
body:
Username: BroGroot
I am sorry. Honestly avicus is my favorite server and I wish to play on it again. I will not use hacks again but I understand that because this is my first time being banned for hacking I will be unbanned in a certain amount of time. I am very sorry and I wished to make my apology. Anyways please know I was guilty and I was wondering how long it usually takes to be unbanned.

title: Ban Appeal

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

When we think that your appeal is good enough, and you have served your current infraction for a long period of time. At the moment, you won't be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
